acceptanceCriteria: Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock consistently identify version 0.2.91 with no unrelated dependency changes.
The three WI-801 Work Item pages and tri-language parity rows are registered before verification.
Release preflight, source quality, candidate build and immutable public/N-1 acceptance can bind the published v0.2.91 artifacts to reviewed main.

The canonical workspace package gate must use bounded package-level parallelism and configurable in-package test threads while preserving deterministic package ordering, fail-closed omission reporting, metadata failure reporting, and compatibility with the existing gate manifest.
goal: Align the workspace and lockfile version to 0.2.91, register the tri-language release Work Item projections, and pass the immutable release preflight without changing Runtime behavior.
intent: Publish ai-cockpit v0.2.91 after the WI-799 root-cause repair

scenarioCoverage.expected: Cargo workspace, lockfile, tri-language release projections, and release policy identify the same v0.2.91 reviewed source.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run version consistency, documentation/parity, governance integrity, source quality, and hosted release preflight checks before any tag push.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The v0.2.91 tag and Release are bound to the reviewed PR merge commit and cannot overwrite an existing mismatched Release or tag.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Pass hosted PR checks, merge the reviewed PR, synchronize main, inspect the exact merge SHA, and push one annotated immutable v0.2.91 tag.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Candidate fresh install and N-1 upgrade use independent isolated roots, published candidate artifacts, and structured cleanup receipts.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the release workflow candidate jobs and their receipts, then verify both candidate acceptance paths and cleanup before publication.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The public v0.2.91 downloaded artifact passes fresh install, v0.2.90 to v0.2.91 upgrade, version consistency, and isolation cleanup.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After publication, inspect public adopter and upgrade acceptance jobs and retain their immutable receipts and manifest digests.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Interruption, timeout, runner/network failure, cleanup failure, or identity mismatch resumes from the earliest invalid phase without unnecessary rebuild, republish, deletion, or history overwrite.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the release recovery regression coverage and inspect phase-bound receipts; treat any identity mismatch as a blocking failure.
